qa_pairs.question: How do you connect to the Alliance Nextcloud service using a WebDAV client on a Mac?
qa_pairs.answer: On a Mac, you can connect by selecting 'Go' then 'Connect to the Server' from the Finder menu. Enter the WebDAV URL 'https://nextcloud.computecanada.ca/remote.php/webdav/' as the Server Address, click 'Connect', and then provide your Alliance username and password. This will mount a WebDAV drive on your Mac.

qa_pairs.question: What is the process for mapping a WebDAV network drive to the Alliance Nextcloud service on Windows?
qa_pairs.answer: To map a WebDAV drive on Windows, use the 'Map Network Drive...' option. Select a drive letter, and then input the WebDAV URL 'https://nextcloud.computecanada.ca/remote.php/webdav/' into the 'Folder' field.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any alternative WebDAV clients recommended for accessing Alliance Nextcloud on Mac or Windows?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Cyberduck is an alternative WebDAV client that can be used on both Mac OSX and Windows for accessing the Alliance Nextcloud service.
